info.name: HeyGen V3
info.description: HeyGen API v3 — Avatar V engine testing. Set the HEYGEN_API_KEY variable before use.

variable.description: Populated by 'Create V3 Video' tests via post-response script

request.description: Returns all available avatars. Filter by supported_api_engines containing 'avatar_v' to find PAOS / Avatar V compatible looks.
Upload a JPEG or PNG to use as a v3 background. Returns { data: { id: '...' } } — use that id as asset_id in background.
Minimal v3 payload — solid color background. No remove_background, no voice_settings.emotion (both cause render failure in v3).

exec: if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('video_id', id); console.log('video_id set:', id); }

request.description: V3 with image background. background.type must be 'image' (not 'video' — v3 rejects 'video'). Use asset_id from the Upload Image Asset request.

request.description: Same payload without the engine field — tests whether HeyGen auto-selects Avatar V for PAOS looks or falls back to a different engine.
Poll every 30s. status: 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed'. video_url is populated when completed.
V2 multi-scene format. caption must be a boolean (true/false) — NOT a dict like {style: 'classic'}. The v2 endpoint is legacy and will be removed; migrate to v3.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "avatar",
  "avatar_id": "REPLACE_WITH_AVATAR_LOOK_ID",
  "script": "This will fail — v3 does not accept video backgrounds.",
  "voice_id": "REPLACE_WITH_VOICE_ID",
  "background": {
    "type": "video",
    "video_asset_id": "REPLACE_WITH_ASSET_ID"
  },
  "engine": { "type": "avatar_v" },
  "resolution": "1080p",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
  "title": "Will Return 400"
}

request.description: EXPECTED FAILURE: HTTP 400 'Input should be color or image'. V3 background.type only accepts 'color' or 'image'. To use a video BG, extract a frame as JPEG, upload it, and use that asset_id with type:'image'.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "avatar",
  "avatar_id": "REPLACE_WITH_AVATAR_LOOK_ID",
  "script": "This will fail — v3 does not accept voice_settings with emotion.",
  "voice_id": "REPLACE_WITH_VOICE_ID",
  "voice_settings": {
    "emotion": "Broadcaster"
  },
  "background": { "type": "color", "value": "#0d1b2a" },
  "engine": { "type": "avatar_v" },
  "resolution": "1080p",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
  "title": "Will Fail at Render"
}

request.description: EXPECTED FAILURE: Submits OK (HTTP 200) but render fails with 'failed' status. V3 voice_settings does not support emotion — drop that field entirely.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "avatar",
  "avatar_id": "REPLACE_WITH_AVATAR_LOOK_ID",
  "script": "This may fail at render — remove_background requires matting-enabled training.",
  "voice_id": "REPLACE_WITH_VOICE_ID",
  "background": { "type": "color", "value": "#0d1b2a" },
  "remove_background": true,
  "engine": { "type": "avatar_v" },
  "resolution": "1080p",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
  "title": "remove_background Test"
}

request.description: LIKELY FAILURE: remove_background requires the avatar to have 'matting-enabled training'. PAOS avatars (Marco, Elise, Elena) do not appear to support it — produces render failure.
EXPECTED FAILURE: HTTP 400 'caption is invalid: Input should be a valid boolean'. In v2, caption must be true or false, not a CaptionSetting object.

item.name: Migration - Option D: Matting Hypothesis
item.description: COSTS CREDITS - run deliberately, not automatically. Tests remove_background on avatar types not covered by the existing 'Known Gotchas' section (which only tested PAOS/avatar_v and found matting failed there). If these succeed, the existing FFmpeg background/PiP pipeline can be kept entirely intact - see HEYGEN_V3_MIGRATION_PLAN.md Option D.

request.description: Tests whether remove_background/matting works for this avatar_type (digital_twin or non-PAOS photo_avatar) - this specific combination was NOT covered by the existing gotcha notes, which only tested PAOS avatars (photo_avatar via avatar_v) and found matting failed there. If this renders with a clean chroma-key-able edge (green background removed), Option D in HEYGEN_V3_MIGRATION_PLAN.md is viable: keep the existing FFmpeg background/PiP pipeline entirely, just swap in this matted V3 clip as the avatar source. Check output frame-by-frame for matting artifacts around hair/edges before deciding.

item.name: Migration - Option A: V3 Studio API Multi-Scene
item.description: COSTS CREDITS - run deliberately. Real type:'studio' request: avatar talks, cuts away to a full-screen narrated image (b-roll), cuts back to the avatar. This is the sequential-cutaway visual style described in HEYGEN_V3_MIGRATION_PLAN.md Option A - no PiP, no moving backdrop (avatar_video scenes are solid-color only), but genuine multi-scene support. Judge the output on its own terms as a different visual style, not as a PiP replacement. Replace the placeholder image URL with a real sourced b-roll image before judging quality.
